title: Som Tam
description: Shredded green papaya pounded in a mortar with chilli, garlic, lime, fish sauce, and palm sugar. Crunchy, sour, and very hot.
notes: In Thailand the number of chillies is the customer's order. Three is medium; one is polite.

steps.text: Pound the garlic and chillies to a rough paste in a large mortar.
Add the palm sugar and dried shrimp and pound until the sugar dissolves into the paste.
Add the yard-long beans and cherry tomatoes and bruise them lightly.
Add the green papaya, fish sauce, and lime juice and pound-and-toss with a spoon, turning the salad over as you go, just until it softens.
steps.tip: A bruise, not a mash. The papaya should still crunch.

steps.text: Taste for sour, salty, and sweet in balance, then serve scattered with the peanuts.
